title: One close everywhere: tab ✕, menu Close and grid pane ✕ all end the session after a confirm

requirements.text: The grid pane ✕ ends the session the same way the tab ✕ does (today closePane at app/Sources/GenlockApp/AppModel.swift:732 only hides it from the split)
requirements.check: eye: in grid mode click a pane's ✕, confirm; switch to non-grid; the session is not in the tabs and is listed under Recently ended

requirements.text: Every close path (tab ✕, tab menu Close Session, project menu Close All Its Sessions, grid pane ✕) asks one confirmation before ending, and Cancel leaves the session untouched
requirements.check: eye: try each of the four; each shows the same confirm; Cancel keeps the session running and visible

requirements.text: A session closed in non-grid mode stays closed: switching modes, clicking its project on the dashboard or top row, and relaunching the app do not bring it back
requirements.check: eye: close a session, then switch grid/non-grid, click its project, quit and relaunch; it does not reappear

requirements.text: The cause of the closed session coming back three times is found and named in the ticket, not just papered over
requirements.check: manual: genlock show lists the cause (code path and line) in a decision or update

requirements.text: Hiding a pane from a split without ending it is still possible, under a different control than ✕ (e.g. the existing split toggle), so ✕ means only one thing
requirements.check: eye: a pane can be removed from the split without ending it, and that control is not an ✕

requirements.text: App builds, core tests pass, DESIGN.md §13 describes the confirm-then-end close
requirements.check: cd app && swift build && swift test

text: Every close (tab ✕, menu Close, grid pane ✕) is the same action: confirm, then end into Recently ended. Supersedes T-2GNT3's no-dialog close.
user_said: i think they should ALL be the same thing, requiringa confirmation to full close. its just getting very confusing

text: Queued. Tab ✕ already ends via closeTab->endNoted (SessionClosing.swift:7, committed 4c01e6c); grid pane ✕ calls closePane (AppModel.swift:732) which only hides, so grid-closed sessions reappear in non-grid. TJ also saw a non-grid close come back 3 times: unexplained; check whether the running app predates 4c01e6c, restoreSessions (AppModel ~L494), and closeSessionsIfAsked (~L927).
spun off T-MFJV8: Sessions show when the agent is waiting on a script, job or queue (do ticket T-WNPB7)

Cause of the close that kept coming back: the pane header ✕ (SessionsView.swift ~L570, in single view as well as grid) called closePane (AppModel.swift:732), which only removed the session from visible and routed to the dashboard; clicking the project then showProject'd the still-running session back. The tab ✕ already ended sessions. Fix: that ✕ now goes through requestClose like every other close.

evidence: Read AppModel.swift: closePane (L732) only removed from visible; showProject (L667-670) shows lastShown[project] if still in sessionKeys, so a pane-✕'d session reappeared on project click. Recorded as decision 2.
swift build: Build complete; swift test: Executed 114 tests, 0 failures; app/DESIGN.md S13 rewritten to confirm-then-end everywhere, split-slash hide control

text: Built, uncommitted: requestClose+confirmClose in SessionClosing.swift, closing state in AppModel, one .alert in RootView (GenlockApp.swift); tab ✕, tab menu, project Close All and pane header ✕ all call requestClose; closePane renamed hidePane behind a split-only split-slash button. 114 tests pass.
